title: Cernoziom, irrigated, Bărăgan plain, mid-September
rationale: All five candidates on 2026-09-13 list cernoziom under requirements.soil.suitable_classes, so nothing is excluded on soil. grau_toamna is asserted into the top because cernoziom is suitable for it, its Bărăgan window (10-11 → 10-20, INCDA Fundulea guidance) opens well inside the 46-day horizon, and its drought tolerance is medie — better than rapita_toamna's scazuta. Nothing in the dictionary separates grau_toamna, orz_toamna, secara and triticale on an irrigated cernoziom with 48.3 mm of forecast rain and only 1 drought year in 10, so no ordering is asserted: this case is deliberately the loosest one in the grid.
